node.statement: Availability gate. The conditional calculation in node 1.3.2.3.1 may be used to conclude the lower and two-sided norm bounds only after nodes 1.3.2.1 and 1.3.2.2 are validated. While either dependency is pending, this branch supplies no unconditional conclusion and node 1.3.2.3 must remain pending.
